title: Check if There is a Valid Path in a Grid
statement: Grid of street types 1..6 starting at top-left; return true if a path to bottom-right exists following street connections.
visualizationCap: each side capped at 12 for the grid view
notes: Street shapes are the standard LeetCode definitions (1 LR, 2 UD, 3 LD, 4 RD, 5 LU, 6 RU).
